name: frontend-workflow
description: Lead-frontend-engineer workflow for Next.js/React/TypeScript with an autopilot: every feature, refactor, fix or change is routed through plan, build, test, verify and review automatically, by subagents with hook-enforced roles.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Classify every request (feature, refactor, fix, change) and run the matching workflow automatically, with hooks enforcing the step order.

plan_approval.title: Plan approval
plan_approval.description: Stop after the plan and wait for your explicit approval ("approve") before any code is written. Feedback revises the plan; "cancel" drops the task.

approval_scope.title: Approval scope
approval_scope.description: Which requests need an approved plan: features and refactors only, or every code change (fixes and small changes get planned too). Quick edits never do.

max_gate_rounds.title: Max gate rounds
max_gate_rounds.description: How many times per task the workflow gates may send Claude back to finish missing steps before giving up and reporting them.

strict_delegation.title: Strict delegation
strict_delegation.description: When on, the main session (lead) may only write docs; all code must go through builder, tester and refactorer subagents.

review_gate.title: Review gate
review_gate.description: Block finishing a turn when code changed and no reviewer subagent ran afterwards.

verify_on_stop.title: Verify on stop
verify_on_stop.description: Run typecheck, lint and related tests on changed files before the lead can finish a turn.

lint_on_edit.title: Format and lint on edit
lint_on_edit.description: Run Prettier and ESLint --fix on every edited file and send remaining errors back immediately.
